```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

path <- here("data", "raw", "nso_cpi_groups_2026-09-28.xlsx")

excel_sheets(path)          # how many sheets, and their names
raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = 1)
dim(raw)                    # rows x columns
head(raw, 15)               # first 15 rows

raw <- read_excel(path, sheet = 1, skip = 1)   # skip the title row

# Step 1a: read it properly and reshape to long format.
cpi_long <- raw |>
  rename(base = 1, group = 2) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(base, group), names_to = "month", values_to = "index") |>
  mutate(index = as.numeric(index),
         date  = ym(month)) |>
  filter(!is.na(index))

# Step 1b: see what each base year covers.
cpi_long |>
  group_by(base) |>
  summarise(start = min(date), end = max(date), n_groups = n_distinct(group))

# Step 1c: headline monthly inflation within each base
headline <- cpi_long |>
  filter(str_detect(group, "^Ерөнхий")) |>
  mutate(base = str_sub(base, 1, 4)) |>          # "2015=100" -> "2015"
  arrange(base, date) |>
  group_by(base) |>
  mutate(pi = 1200 * log(index / lag(index))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(pi))

# Step 1d: compare the bases where they overlap
headline |>
  select(base, date, pi) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = base, values_from = pi) |>
  filter(date >= ym("2010-02"), date <= ym("2022-07")) |>
  summarise(max_diff_15_23 = max(abs(`2015` - `2023`)),
            max_diff_20_23 = max(abs(`2020` - `2023`)),
            cor_15_23      = cor(`2015`, `2023`))

# Step 1e: find the gaps
overlap <- headline |>
  select(base, date, pi) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = base, values_from = pi) |>
  filter(date >= ym("2010-02"), date <= ym("2022-07")) |>
  mutate(diff = `2015` - `2023`)

overlap |> arrange(desc(abs(diff))) |> select(date, `2015`, `2023`, diff) |> head(10)
overlap |> summarise(cor = cor(`2015`, `2023`), mean_abs_diff = mean(abs(diff)))

ggplot(overlap, aes(date, diff)) + geom_col()

overlap |>
  group_by(year = year(date)) |>
  summarise(mean_abs_diff = mean(abs(diff)))

# Step 1f: build the clean series and save it
pi_2023 <- headline |>
  filter(base == "2023") |>
  select(date, index, pi)

# sanity check: every month present, no gaps
identical(pi_2023$date, seq(ym("2010-02"), ym("2026-08"), by = "month"))

pi_ts <- ts(pi_2023$pi, start = c(2010, 2), frequency = 12)
saveRDS(pi_2023, here("data", "state_space", "headline_pi_2023base.rds"))
```

## Also save the 2015-base headline series (for robustness check B)

```{r}
pi_2015 <- headline |>
  filter(base == "2015") |>
  select(date, index, pi)

saveRDS(pi_2015, here("data", "state_space", "headline_pi_2015base.rds"))
range(pi_2015$date)
```
